name: Song Silk & Mineral Gold
zh: 宋韵古绢 × 矿物岩彩描金
summary: Museum-grade Song-dynasty Blue-and-Green mineral painting on tea-aged woven silk (#C8B490) with real warp/weft thread relief, crushed Azurite (石青), Malachite (石绿), Cinnabar (朱砂), Ochre (赭石) and Shell-White (蛤粉) crystal granulation, 24K specular mud-gold contour lines (泥金复勾) that glint under roving candlelight, mud-gold ruled calligraphy columns (泥金乌丝栏), and porous Cinnabar seal stamps. Supports both 16:9 horizontal album-leaf/handscroll (1920×1080) and 3:4 vertical hanging-scroll (1080×1440) compositions.
